description: This file defines a validation rule class, TimesheetCommentDateParamRule, within the OrangeHRM Time module. It validates whether a given date falls within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet identified by ID.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentDateParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a provided date is within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input date is within the timesheet's start and end dates.
